A company runs a containerized application using Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) and the Kubernetes Horizontal Pod Autoscaler. The workload varies throughout the day. A solutions architect notices that nodes do not scale automatically when the existing nodes reach the cluster's maximum capacity, causing performance problems. Which solution addresses this issue with the LEAST administrative overhead?
Scale nodes by tracking memory utilization.
Use Kubernetes Cluster Autoscaler to manage the number of nodes in the cluster.
Use an AWS Lambda function to automatically resize the EKS cluster.
Use Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling groups to distribute the workload.

A company that uses AWS Organizations runs 150 applications across 30 AWS accounts. The company creates a new AWS Cost and Usage Report in the management account. The report is delivered to an Amazon S3 bucket that is replicated to a bucket in a data collection account. Senior leadership wants a custom dashboard updated daily that shows NAT gateway costs from the beginning of the current month. Which solution meets these requirements?
Share an Amazon QuickSight dashboard with the requested table visualization. Configure QuickSight to query the new report using AWS DataSync.
Share an Amazon QuickSight dashboard with the requested table visualization. Configure QuickSight to query the new report using Amazon Athena.
Share an Amazon CloudWatch dashboard with the requested table visualization. Configure CloudWatch to query the new report using AWS DataSync.
Share an Amazon CloudWatch dashboard with the requested table visualization. Configure CloudWatch to query the new report using Amazon Athena.

A company's on-premises volume backup solution is approaching end of life. The company wants to use AWS as part of a new backup solution while retaining local access to all data. Data backed up to AWS must be transferred automatically and securely. Which solution meets these requirements?
Use AWS Snowball to migrate data from the on-premises solution to Amazon S3. Configure on-premises systems to mount the Snowball S3 endpoint for local data access.
Use AWS Snowball Edge to migrate data from the on-premises solution to Amazon S3. Use the Snowball Edge file interface to provide local data access to on-premises systems.

Use AWS Storage Gateway and configure a cached volume gateway. Run the Storage Gateway software appliance on premises and configure a portion of the data to be cached locally. Mount the gateway storage volumes to provide local data access.

Use AWS Storage Gateway and configure a stored volume gateway. Run the Storage Gateway software appliance on premises and map the gateway storage volumes to local storage. Mount the gateway storage volumes to provide local data access.

A company has an Amazon S3 data lake managed by AWS Lake Formation. The company wants to create Amazon QuickSight visualizations by joining data in the data lake with operational data stored in an Amazon Aurora MySQL database. The company must enforce column-level authorization so that the marketing team can access only certain database columns. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
Use Amazon EMR to import data directly from the database into the QuickSight SPICE engine. Include only the required columns.

Use AWS Glue Studio to import data from the database into the S3 data lake. Attach IAM policies to QuickSight users to enforce column-level access control. Use Amazon S3 as the data source in QuickSight.

Use AWS Glue Elastic Views to create materialized views of the database in Amazon S3. Create an S3 bucket policy to enforce column-level access control for QuickSight users. Use Amazon S3 as the data source in QuickSight.

Use Lake Formation blueprints to import data from the database into the S3 data lake. Use Lake Formation to enforce column-level access control for QuickSight users. Use Amazon Athena as the data source in QuickSight.

A company runs a custom application on Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances. The application's frontend nodes must run continuously, while backend nodes run for short periods as the workload requires. The number of backend nodes varies throughout the day. The company needs to scale out and scale in instances according to the workload. Which solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
Use Reserved Instances for the frontend nodes. Use AWS Fargate for the backend nodes.
Use Reserved Instances for the frontend nodes. Use Spot Instances for the backend nodes.
Use Spot Instances for the frontend nodes. Use Reserved Instances for the backend nodes.
Use Spot Instances for the frontend nodes. Use AWS Fargate for the backend nodes.

A company has resources across multiple AWS Regions and accounts. A newly hired solutions architect discovers that former employees did not provide a detailed resource inventory. The solutions architect needs to build a map of the relationships among the various workloads in all accounts. Which solution meets these requirements MOST operationally efficiently?
Use AWS Systems Manager Inventory to generate a map view from a detailed view report.
Use AWS Step Functions to collect workload details. Manually build architecture diagrams of the workloads.
Use Workload Discovery on AWS to generate architecture diagrams of the workloads.
Use AWS X-Ray to view workload details. Build architecture diagrams with the relationships.

A company has an online gaming application with TCP and UDP multiplayer functionality. The company uses Amazon Route 53 to direct application traffic to multiple Network Load Balancers (NLBs) in different AWS Regions. The company needs to improve application performance and reduce online gaming latency as the number of users grows. Which solution meets these requirements?
Add an Amazon CloudFront distribution in front of the NLBs. Increase the Cache-Control max-age parameter.
Replace the NLBs with Application Load Balancers (ALBs). Configure Route 53 to use latency-based routing.
Add AWS Global Accelerator in front of the NLBs. Configure a Global Accelerator endpoint to use the correct listener ports.
Add Amazon API Gateway endpoints behind the NLBs. Enable API caching. Override method caching for different stages.

A company has a nightly batch job that analyzes report files received daily through SFTP into an on-premises file system. The company wants to migrate the solution to the AWS Cloud. The solution must be highly available and resilient and must minimize operational overhead. Which solution meets these requirements?

Deploy AWS Transfer for SFTP and an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system for storage. Use Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group with a scheduled scaling policy to perform the batch operations.

Deploy an Amazon EC2 instance running Linux and an SFTP service. Use an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume for storage. Use an Auto Scaling group with a minimum capacity and desired capacity of 1.

Deploy an Amazon EC2 instance running Linux and an SFTP service. Use an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system for storage. Use an Auto Scaling group with a minimum capacity and desired capacity of 1.

Deploy AWS Transfer for SFTP and an Amazon S3 bucket. Modify the application to pull batch files from Amazon S3 to an Amazon EC2 instance for processing. Use an EC2 instance in an Auto Scaling group with a scheduled scaling policy to perform the batch operations.

A company is building a data analytics platform on AWS using AWS Lake Formation. The platform will ingest data from sources such as Amazon S3 and Amazon RDS. The company needs a secure solution that prevents access to portions of the data containing sensitive information. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
Create an IAM role with permissions to access Lake Formation tables.
Create data filters to implement row-level security and cell-level security.
Create an AWS Lambda function to remove sensitive information before the data is imported into Lake Formation.
Create an AWS Lambda function to periodically query and remove sensitive information from Lake Formation tables.

A company exposes its application to the internet through an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The company discovers unusual traffic access patterns in the application. A solutions architect needs to improve infrastructure visibility to help the company understand these anomalies. What is the MOST operationally efficient solution?
Create a table in Amazon Athena for AWS CloudTrail logs. Create a query to retrieve the relevant information.
Enable ALB access logging to Amazon S3. Create a table in Amazon Athena and query the logs.
Enable ALB access logging to Amazon S3. Open each file in a text editor and search each line for relevant information.
Use Amazon EMR on a dedicated Amazon EC2 instance to query the ALB directly for traffic access log information.

A company connects its corporate data center to a VPC in us-east-1 through an AWS Direct Connect connection. The company recently acquired another company that has multiple VPCs and a Direct Connect connection between its on-premises data center and eu-west-2. The companies' VPC CIDR blocks do not overlap. The company needs connectivity between the two Regions and the data centers. The solution must be scalable and reduce operational overhead. How should a solutions architect meet these requirements?
Establish inter-Region VPC peering between the VPCs in us-east-1 and the VPCs in eu-west-2.
Create a private virtual interface from the Direct Connect connection in us-east-1 to the VPCs in eu-west-2.
Deploy VPN appliances hosted on Amazon EC2 in a full-mesh VPN network. Use AWS VPN CloudHub to send and receive data between the data centers and each VPC.
Connect the existing Direct Connect connections to a Direct Connect gateway. Route traffic from the virtual private gateways of the VPCs in each Region to the Direct Connect gateway.

A company's application runs on Amazon EC2 instances across multiple Availability Zones. The application must receive data from a third-party application in real time. The company needs a data ingestion solution that places the collected raw data into an Amazon S3 bucket. Which solution meets these requirements?

Create an Amazon Kinesis data stream for data ingestion. Create an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream to consume the Kinesis data stream. Specify the S3 bucket as the delivery stream's destination.

Create a database migration task in AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS). Specify a replication instance for the EC2 instances as the source endpoint. Specify the S3 bucket as the target endpoint. Set the migration type to migrate existing data and replicate ongoing changes.
Create and configure an AWS DataSync agent on the EC2 instances. Configure a DataSync task to transfer data from the EC2 instances to the S3 bucket.

Create an AWS Direct Connect connection for data ingestion. Create an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream to consume PUT operations directly from the application. Specify the S3 bucket as the delivery stream's destination.

A disaster response team uses drones to collect images of damage caused by a recent storm. The team's laptops lack the storage and compute capacity to transfer the images and process the data. Although the team has Amazon EC2 instances for processing and Amazon S3 buckets for storage, network connectivity is intermittent and unreliable. The images must be processed to assess the damage. What should a solutions architect recommend?
Use an AWS Snowball Edge device to process and store the images.
Upload the images to Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) during periods of intermittent connectivity to the EC2 instances.
Configure Amazon Data Firehose with separate delivery streams for the S3 buckets and EC2 instances to process the images.
Use AWS Storage Gateway preinstalled on a hardware appliance to cache the images locally so that Amazon S3 can process them when connectivity is available.

A company hosts its ecommerce application in the AWS Cloud. The application uses a multi-Region active-active approach and multiple microservices. The company needs a solution that redirects traffic when resources in an AWS Region become unavailable. The company wants to ensure that the failover Region can handle the traffic during a failover. Which solution provides application resilience with the LEAST operational overhead?
Use the multi-Region recovery capabilities of Amazon Route 53 Application Recovery Controller.

Use Amazon Route 53 health checks to monitor multi-Region endpoints and redirect traffic. Use Amazon EventBridge Scheduler to schedule occasional resource shutdowns in the primary Region to verify that the failover Region is ready to handle traffic.
Use AWS Fault Injection Service to reroute traffic to another Region if resources in one Region become unavailable.

Deploy Amazon API Gateway HTTP APIs in each Region. Use an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Use Lambda@Edge to query Amazon Route 53 for the Region to which requests should be forwarded based on the lowest latency.

A company is developing a social media application. The company expects rapid and unpredictable growth in users and data volume. The application must continuously process large numbers of user requests, including long-running processes that store large amounts of user-generated content and user profiles in a relational format. The processes must run in a specific order. The architecture must scale resources during demand spikes without downtime or performance degradation. Individual components must be able to evolve independently without affecting the rest of the system. Which combination of AWS services meets these requirements?

Deploy the application on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) using the AWS Fargate launch type. Use Amazon RDS as the database. Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to decouple message processing between components.

Deploy the application on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) using the AWS Fargate launch type. Use Amazon RDS as the database. Use Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to decouple message processing between components.

Use Amazon DynamoDB as the database. Implement the application with AWS Lambda functions. Configure Amazon DynamoDB Streams to invoke the Lambda functions. Use AWS Step Functions to manage workflows between services.

Deploy the application in an AWS Elastic Beanstalk environment with automatic scaling. Use Amazon RDS as the database. Use Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to decouple message processing between components.

A company deploys an application in two AWS Regions. If the application becomes unavailable in one Region, it must fail over to the second Region. The failover process must avoid stale DNS client caches. The company wants a single endpoint to access both copies of the application. Which solution meets these requirements?
Use an Amazon CloudFront distribution with multiple origins. Associate each origin with the application in its respective Region.
Use an Amazon Route 53 weighted routing policy with equal weights to route client requests when the original Region becomes unavailable.
Use AWS Global Accelerator and assign a static anycast IP address to the application endpoint.
Use an Amazon Route 53 IP-based routing policy to route requests to the second Region if the application becomes unavailable in the original Region.

A company operates an online photo-sharing service and stores data in a centralized Amazon S3 bucket in AWS account A. The company wants to grant a second AWS account, account B, access to the centralized S3 bucket. The company owns account B. Which solution meets this requirement?
Enable S3 Transfer Acceleration so that account B can access the centralized S3 bucket in account A.
Enable cross-Region replication between account A and account B to share the S3 bucket data.
Use Amazon CloudFront to distribute the S3 bucket contents. Grant account B access to the bucket contents through signed URLs.
Create a bucket policy that allows account B to access the centralized S3 bucket in account A.

A company manages an application that stores data in an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL Multi-AZ DB instance. High application traffic increases the latency of many read queries. A solutions architect must improve the application's performance. Which solution meets this requirement?
Enable Amazon RDS Performance Insights. Configure storage autoscaling.
Configure the DB instance to use DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX).
Create a read replica of the DB instance. Serve read traffic from the read replica.
Use Amazon Data Firehose between the application and Amazon RDS to increase database request concurrency.

A company wants to optimize the cost of its AWS infrastructure. The company wants to receive notifications when actual or forecasted costs exceed a specified budget. The company does not want to develop a custom solution. Which solution meets these requirements?

Use AWS Trusted Advisor to set up budget notifications. Configure Amazon CloudWatch to monitor costs. Export the CloudWatch data to Amazon S3. Use machine learning (ML) to estimate future trends based on the CloudWatch data.

Create a budget in AWS Budgets with a specific cost threshold. Create an AWS Lambda function to notify the company when costs reach the specified threshold. Use AWS Billing and Cost Management reports to monitor costs.

Use AWS Cost Explorer to set a specified budget threshold. Create an AWS Lambda function to calculate cost estimates. Configure the function to notify an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic if estimated costs exceed the threshold.

Create a budget in AWS Budgets with a specific cost threshold. Configure AWS Budgets to send budget alerts to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Use AWS Cost Explorer to monitor costs.

A company has a website that handles a dynamically changing traffic load. The website runs on Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group configured for scheduled scaling. Each EC2 instance runs code from an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) volume and writes shared data to the same volume. The company wants to optimize the website's cost. Which solution meets this requirement?
Reconfigure the Auto Scaling group with a fixed desired number of instances. Disable scheduled scaling.
Create a new launch template version for the Auto Scaling group that uses larger EC2 instances.
Reconfigure the Auto Scaling group to use a target tracking scaling policy.
Replace the EFS volume with instance store volumes.
